rationale: Identity was verified using full name and zip, matched to a single user via tool. The agent located the relevant delivered order and correctly identified the two items. They explored product variants using tools and proposed valid options, honoring the user’s preference for AC adapter for the lamp. Before making any changes, the agent summarized the intended exchanges and requested confirmation; when the user limited the request to the desk lamp only, the agent reconfirmed that specific change. Only after explicit confirmation did the agent execute the exchange via the correct tool with the correct item IDs and payment method. The tool returned an exchange with a $5.08 price difference, which the agent relayed accurately, along with standard next steps. No unsupported claims, no actions on the wrong account, and no writes without prior confirmation. The water bottle exchange was not performed per the user’s final instruction.
